authoritative_for: CRM owns profile and case identities, stored Markdown and intake, immutable case revisions, stages and advisories. It also owns update and retry lifecycles, requester correlations, replay-safe tool receipts, deterministic library reads and product packaging.
not_authoritative_for: Callers supply library material and handle contact actions. Nucleus owns agent execution.

covers: All supported public CRM CLI outcomes for profile maintenance, case maintenance, library exploration, installation and steward operation, and product development in this release.
excludes: Help and version display, direct SQLite access, the hidden worker entry point, automatic source collection, contact delivery, direct model execution, and current runtime readiness are outside this inventory claim.

shared_access_and_trust: CRM operations use the local CLI and a selected local database. Only hidden update work uses Nucleus and the immutable crm/case-steward/1 toolset.
shared_privacy_and_retention: CRM and correlated Nucleus state may retain private profile, case, source, prompt, advisory, and tool-result text; release bundles and provider contracts contain no user case data.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release identifies these exact bundle bytes; CLI JSON contract, database schema, requester toolset, and Nucleus protocol remain separate compatibility axes.
operational_limits: CRM has no daemon, scheduler, source crawler, contact sender, filesystem content store, or direct-Codex fallback; per-entry bounds govern each explicit operation.
